purpose: Requirements for the agent-review backend: a read-only, dependency-free reviewer Agent that runs one round per Agent, declares availability and retains_context=false.
summary: Background: default review must work without external tools, message DB, or resident sessions
Scope: availability check, read-only reviewer, retains_context=false; excludes launching, fixing, history, fallback
FNC-1601: reviewer is read-only and may only write findings through its dedicated script
FNC-1602: a fresh Agent per round, no context inherited across rounds
FNC-1604: side-effect-free availability check of definition, read-only constraints, scripts and docs
FNC-1606: no review history persisted and no resume with the same review_id
NFR-1601: non-persistence, no DB, history files, resident processes or reused sessions
NFR-1602: no external dependencies beyond the plugin and host custom Agent facility
NFR-1603: fail closed, unconfirmed availability or read-only is reported unavailable with reason
Acceptance criteria: distinct Agents per round, tool restrictions, availability reporting, no leftover resources
tasks: Writing or editing the reviewer Agent definition and tool constraints
Reviewing the agent-review requirements or design
Writing acceptance tests for the review backend
